messages.subject: For Per Narvinger | Global affairs, government relations and digital infrastructure
messages.body:
Dear Ericsson Global Media Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Per Narvinger, President and Chief Executive Officer, where appropriate.

Ericsson operates across digital infrastructure, public policy, national connectivity priorities and international partnerships. That stakeholder environment closely matches the external leadership work I manage today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, corporate affairs, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across complex multinational operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation regarding roles where this combination of global affairs, government relations and emerging-market stakeholder execution could support Ericsson internationally. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Ericsson.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
